notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 Released
notes.content: This build includes more updates for the Memory minigame, including a new skip button ("Avoid this Fate"). The button was added in case the player runs into the rare Memory minigame softlock bug so they can continue playing. Happily, it also allows for a new gameplay mechanic where everyone can weigh the risk of playing the Memory game for boon cards against getting cursed cards. Enjoy, travelers!

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 Released!
notes.content: This version includes bug and performance fixes, plus a fix for a potential exploit in curse selection.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 Released
notes.content:
This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements, including:

[list]
[*] Faster load time for game boards
[*] Updated launch icons
[*] Fix for background music sometimes not looping properly
[*] Fix for events that could sometimes offer a duplicate card from an extra suit
[*] Fixed a typo in the displayed formula for scoring weakened curse cards
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.7
notes.content: Fixed an issue where clicking a Freeze card would not reliably unselect previously selected cards.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Notes
notes.content: Fixed a possible exploit in the "memory" minigame that allowed players to peek at each card before selecting it in matches.
